items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XV, List of Answers on Terminology 96:1
items.html: (To the question) What is the true AB? The stature of AB bestowed to the Nukva at the time that she is in a face-to-face coupling with ZA is discerned as the true AB, namely as the aspect of the Mochin of Chaya, which are the Mochin of birth. But the aspect of the AB of SAG, MAH, and BAN, which she receives at the time that she is in the back of ZA, in order to complete her vessels, is discerned as an AB that is only the aspect of the NRN of AB, and not actual AB. For before her vessels are completed in a complete stature, she cannot receive the aspect of complete Mochin. (Item 104).
